Committee: Governmental Affairs
Sponsor: Price
Analyst: Vee Mosely
Date: 01/27/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 43 as introduced will increase the obligations of the Alabama Emergency Management Agency, the Alabama Association of Emergency Managers and the Association of County Commissions of Alabama, by an undetermined amount, to develop uniform guidelines regarding safer place facilities (for use during severe weather events) that meet the provisions of this bill by December 31, 2021.
Jimmy Holley, Chairperson
Governmental Affairs

FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 43 as passed the Senate will increase the obligations of the Alabama Emergency Management Agency, the Alabama Association of Emergency Managers and the Association of County Commissions of Alabama, by an undetermined amount, to develop uniform guidelines regarding safer place facilities (for use during severe weather events) that meet the provisions of this bill by December 31, 2021.
Chris Pringle, Chair
State Government
